messages:
Jules Park: Welcome Olivia! Quick heads-up — when you get a sec can you fill out the hardware prefs in Workday? If you need a laptop or monitor tell me :wave:
Olivia Chen: Hi all! Thanks — super excited to join the infra-eng team. Quick q: I don't see org repo access yet and my laptop delivery got delayed. Who should I ping for access or a loaner?
Mike Tran: @Olivia Chen welcome!! Repo invites usually come from eng-ops. DM me your work email and I'll escalate. Also if laptop delayed we can issue a loaner.
Anya Ramirez: Hey Olivia! I scheduled a 30m intro tomorrow at 10:00am PT to walk through the codebase and runbook — feel free to bring any questions.
Olivia Chen: Thanks @Mike @Anya — my email is olivia.chen@redwood.test
EngOncall Bot: provisioning-ticket created: PROV-8421 — assigned to eng-ops. ETA for initial access: ~2–24 hours depending on ops queue.
Mike Tran: FYI, also add yourself to #eng-runtime and #eng-platform channels. I sent the repo invite just now.
Jules Park: Small onboarding thing — for badge/building access People Ops handles the badge but EngOps submits the building pass. I'll CC Maria from people-ops in DMs.
Olivia Chen: Got the invite and accepted. One more thing — who do I ask about VPN + VPC dev project access?
Mike Tran: For VPN and cloud permissions ping eng-infra (and fill the infra access form at https://intranet.redwood/infra-access). If you want quicker access, loop me and I'll raise with infra oncall.
Anya Ramirez: Also quick dev setup hint — run the quick script after you accept the invite:
```
./scripts/dev_setup.sh --quick
```
Olivia Chen: Fun fact time: I collect vintage train timetables and my go-to weird combo is peanut butter + dill pickles :joy: Looking forward to pairing with you all!
Jules Park: Love the timetables. Welcome again — looking forward to working with you :tada:
Mike Tran: Welcome aboard :rocket:
Anya Ramirez: Welcome! See you tomorrow for the 10am intro :coffee:
